name: Tales Of Tirunia
detailed_description:
Tales of Tirunia is a turn-based strategy game which rewards careful placement and future thinking. Every placement of your units on the board can be the masterstroke that drags the entire game in your favour– or it can leave you open to a critical counterstroke by enemy forces. Units that are overpowered by attacks from surrounding enemies flip allegiance– and can chain those attacks onwards across the entire board. Special abilities for each faction– the raw damage-boosting of the Wild Terins or the cursed power of the Bog Fiends– create tense tactical situations.

FEATURES

  • Hop into intense PVP, testing your strategic skills against other players. Prove your mastery, climb the ranks and become the best Strategist in the universe!

  • Multiple armies with distinctive playstyles and interactions means that there is no limit to what you can learn and discover on Tirunia. Will you fight as the untamed Wild Terins, boasting raw power and simple, brutal abilities, or as their more “civilized” High Terin counterparts, focusing on area lockdown? Will you emerge from the fog with the decay-timer-based Bog Fiends? Take the time to master each army and unlock their full potential as you fight your way across the island!

  • The right placement can turn your enemy’s most powerful unit– and its devastating abilities– to your own advantage. The wrong placement can leave your entire army up for grabs. Outwit your opponents to achieve true dominance over the board!

  • Manage your economy, buy materials, craft items and equip them onto your units to catch your enemy off guard! Each item provides a powerful effect that can turn even the weakest unit into an overwhelming force of nature.

MONETIZATION

  • No lootboxes, no pay-to-win, ever!

  • Certain cosmetic items will be locked behind real currency.

  • Trade everything else on the Steam marketplace.

CHOOSE YOUR WAY TO PLAY

Hop into PVP and prove your mastery against online opponents. Choose your favourite army from the High Terins and Wild Terins, the accursed Bog Fiends, the strange command-based Hive army, or the endlessly evolving Radiants– find the perfect strategies for your playstyle! New armies and game-modes will be continuously added, so there will always be new ways to play!

MASTER A SUBTLE BOARD-CONTROL SYSTEM

Wherever a unit is placed, it attacks neighbouring enemies, with different combat values in each direction; a higher value than the opponent means that control of the enemy unit, its abilities, and its board-space is flipped. Different units have different chaining capabilities, sometimes causing the effects of one placement to ripple all the way from one end of the board to the other– and the most powerful units have devastating special abilities that define their armies and change the flow of play. 

MANAGE YOUR ECONOMY AND CRAFT ITEMS TO TURN THE TIDES OF THE BATTLE

Use the gold you earn through capturing enemy units and managing your economy to buy materials from the shop - then craft those materials into powerful items and equip them onto your units to turn the tides of the battle, or to set up traps for your enemy.

THE TREASURE AND SECRETS OF TERINIA ARE UP FOR GRABS!

Once thought to be just a mythical story for children, the island of Terinia has suddenly reemerged onto the surface of the planet. Hidden away from the rest of the universe for centuries, the island has developed a powerful civilization in the High Terins, capable of wielding arcane magic and technology. But the forests and plains are stalked by the Wild Terins, savage and bestial. With the rest of the world suddenly pouring in to claim this rediscovered territory and its powerful resources, who will finally rise to gain full control of Tirunia?

short_description: Tales of Tirunia is a turn-based strategy game focused on turning your enemy’s own units against them and chaining attacks to take as much area as possible! Choose your army, master your faction’s special abilities, and use your skills to claim the board!
